items.html: And behold, the Hei of Elokim of the Mochin of Hochma: its form is Dalet-Yud. And the reason is that it was explained above that the Vav within the Hei indicates ZA that is within Bina. And behold, when the ZA of Hochma is still within the Mochin of Hochma, it is in the secret of a small drop of Yud, which is the drop of insemination of the male waters (mayin dechurin).
